Frequently Asked Questions

Is my video uploaded to a server?

No. The sound is removed entirely in your browser and your video never leaves your device.

Does muting lower the video quality?

No. The picture is copied exactly as it is; only the sound track is left out.

What format is the result?

The same format as your video, so an MP4 stays an MP4.

Can I remove only part of the sound?

This tool removes the whole sound track.
